notes.title: Cards and Guns is available now!
notes.content:
Cards and Guns officially launches on Steam today, May 2. A top-down arena shooter roguelite, where you’ll have to defeat hordes of creatures. Choose from a variety of cards and upgrades to create unique builds and survive to the end.

[previewyoutube=7NvdQW7o8lk;full][/previewyoutube]

Today marks the culmination of several months of dedicated development and unwavering passion. We are thrilled to present our video game to you. We've poured our hearts into creating an experience we hope you'll enjoy as much as we do. Your feedback is invaluable to us, and we eagerly anticipate hearing your thoughts. Thank you for joining us on this journey, and may you find joy in the world we've crafted.

With gratitude,
Family Devs.

notes.title: Cards and Guns participates in the Steam SHMUP Fest
notes.content:
Hello community,

We are very proud to announce that Cards and Guns is participating in the Steam SHMUP Fest!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43860982/c0943f400557c46b2eb7ed482f96107bcdf01059.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43860982/8a59db0201cfe161ae1603aa70f8dd4f98130b8a.jpg[/img]

We are all ears!

Best regards,

notes.title: Huge and New Update! - Cards and Guns
notes.content:
Hello community,

Another update with additions, fixes and revisions.

Many of the changes are thanks to feedback from our playtesting period on Gameround.

Thank you for your support!

Best regards,
Family Devs.

[h2]Cards and Guns - 0.6.0[/h2]

[h3]ADDED[/h3]

[list]
[*] Two new game modes.
[*] New achievements.
[*] New music.
[*] New backgrounds/biomes.
[*] New loot.
[*] Destructible objects.
[*] Global leaderboard.
[*] Auto aim toggle in the Settings menu.
[*] VFX when the player takes damage.
[*] VFX when the player dies.
[*] At the end of the wave, the resources come to the player.
[*] Bosses and Elites drop better loot.
[/list]

[h3]UPDATED[/h3]

[list]
[*] Now the "Select controls" menu is no longer displayed. The game automatically detects the controls according to the player's behaviour.
[*] Player and enemy collision box.
[*] HP are not reset at the start of a new wave.
[*] Difficulty.
[*] The reroll price in shops is reset every time you finish a wave.
[*] Improved menus.
[*] Behaviour of some cards.
[*] Improvements in the translation into Spanish and Catalan.
[/list]

[h3]FIXED[/h3]

[list]
[*] A bug that causes the music to stop.
[*] Several minor issues.
[/list]

notes.title: New languages available!
notes.content:
Hello community,

Another update with additions, fixes and revisions. You can now play the demo in Simplified Chinese, Japanese and Korean.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43860982/3509df348f25b37a0c5ca8d534b51fab3196002c.jpg[/img]

If you wish to collaborate in the translation and proofreading of the in-game texts, please write to us by Discord or email us at contact@familydevs.com


Of course, your name will appear in the credits of the game!

Best regards,
Family Devs.

[h3]UPDATED[/h3]

[*] Luck description. Some players do not understand what is involved in improving this stat.
[*] The "Vision Range" stat is now called “Gun’s Range”. Some players do not understand what is involved in improving this stat.

[/list]


[h3]FIXED[/h3]

[list]
[*] Character hit box.
[*] Turret hit box.
[*] A bug in the "Cards Selection" menu.
[*] Some texts are not translated.
[*] The character shoots at enemies that do not really exist.
[*] Elites overlap with each other and with other enemies.
[/list]

[b]Cards and Guns[/b] is a top-down arena shooter roguelite, where you’ll have to defeat hordes of creatures. Choose from a variety of cards and upgrades to create unique builds and survive to the end.
